trigger.description: The store-local authentication root (ADR 0086 TC-D14) cannot be established or verified because the workspace key directory is missing, malformed, symlinked, readable beyond the owner, or fails its known-answer/integrity self-check. Existing artifact-producing callers may surface their documented unauthenticated-artifact posture. Lane approval callers are stricter: explicit preview-token issuance and `ee mesh grant` return a high-severity `ee.error.v2` failure with no success artifact, bearer, lane mutation, or audit row.

expected_emission.repair_string: Restrict the key directory to 0700 and the key file to 0600 (owner-only), then re-run.
